course.title: Computer Graphics and Image Processing
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Design a Butterworth Lowpass Filter (BLPF) to smooth an image. How can you choose the cut-off frequency ${ \bf D } _ { 0 }$ to pass α percent of image power? Also explain why the lower order BLPF is more preferable than higher order one.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
